summary.name: Courier mail server
summary.one_liner: Courier is a mail server suite (ESMTP, IMAP, POP3, webmail, mailing lists, and basic calendaring) whose source code is hosted in Git repositories.
use_cases: building the mail server from git source
summary.what_it_does: The page is the repository and build page for the Courier mail server source distribution, which includes the Courier IMAP server, sqwebmail, maildrop, and Cone. It explains that building from Git requires extra tools such as autoconf, automake, libtool, gettext, sysconftool, the Courier Unicode Library, and Docbook documentation toolchains. The source is split across two Git repositories: the main courier repository and a shared courier-libs repository. Generated configure and Makefile scripts are not stored in the repository and are produced by the autobloat script via the INSTALLME process. The page does not describe end-user features in detail beyond the component list.
notable: Bundles IMAP, maildrop, sqwebmail, and Cone into one source distribution
Source split across courier and courier-libs Git repositories
Build requires autoconf, automake, libtool and Docbook toolchain when building from Git
caveats: Building from Git needs many extra build dependencies; packaged tarballs avoid most of them
Generated configure and Makefile scripts are not in the repository and must be built with autobloat
